messages.text: That form for the museum still on the printer?
Yes. I just need Mom to check the address dates. The county box was straightforward.
Good. I can drop it by the courthouse in the morning if that saves you gas.
Thanks. Also leaving the candidate notes on the table if you want to skim them before dinner.
Before class, can you copy the number from that office card onto the wall calendar? I do not want it lost under sketch paper.
Done. I put a sticky note too: ask price first and ask if they have anything after 4.
Good. Also, on the form, only write what a doctor has actually told you. Blank is better than guessing.
Okay. I am taking the long way across campus first so I can get my hands to quit shaking before critique.
Before I take our envelope by the office, can you send me the three art payment screenshots from February?
Yeah. I have $90, $45, and $45 in PayPal from the portrait, flyer, and cleanup thing.
That is fine. I just want the folder to match what Dad and I are handing in, since you are still listed with us.
Sending them now. This month is still empty so far, unless somebody finally answers.
Can you get me from the gym side today? bus line is chaos
Yeah but I have to stop at Kroger first. Denise added milk and trash bags to the list.
Carl said check the tire before you leave. also get chips if the list police allows it
Fine, but you unload the back seat when we get in.
your paint boards are on the kitchen chair again
I know. I need the window light before I put them away. Three more photos and then the chair is free.
the chair website gets updated before the actual chair gets liberated?
Maybe. The last batch is still sitting in drafts, so don't bet on it.
Your mama said you might stop by Thursday. I found that feed-sack square with the blue flowers if you still want to look at it.
If you come by Sunday, would you bring the green songbook from my hall shelf? The one with your great-granddaddy's name inside.
Yes please. I want to draw the stitching where the corners don't quite meet.
Yes ma'am. Is it the one with the loose page for I'll Fly Away tucked in the back?
That was your great-aunt's doing. She never did measure, just held it up to the window and fussed till it looked right.
That's the part I like. The little uneven places say more than a perfect pattern.
That's it. Your mama used to sing that too loud at suppers when she was little.
I can hear her doing that. I'll put it in my tote so I don't forget.
Your tire is wearing funny. Shop said about $390 if we do both before it gets worse.
I can't cover that this week. My checking is basically groceries, gas, and the museum parking pass.
We'll figure it out. I can front it Friday if you keep up with your phone and insurance.
Thank you. At least the school portal and the blue card app both show nothing due right now.
Checked your tires while I had the compressor out. They are fine for a run up toward Gatlinburg if you and your friend pick a weekend.
Thank you. I was comparing Cades Cove cabins with that Italy photo class page and the cabins look like actual numbers humans can pay.
Mountains first. Big plane stuff after you get more saved up.
Fair. Also I still need those little passport pictures before I can even pretend.
You still have the library bag in your car? I saw the cover with the lady floating through space lol
Yes, and don't bend that one. I waited two weeks for it.
Fine. Also after dishes can we finish the part with the raccoon guy and then do one round on the Switch
One round if you don't eat all the popcorn before I sit down.
I typed a whole story box about tomorrow and then erased it. Can I just send you the ugly progress pics instead?
yes. send the worst corner first. we are making one list, not a dramatic funeral for charcoal paper.
the gold frame from the church sale actually looks less haunted with blue fabric behind it
Mara already saw the coffee-stained thumbnails and did not block me, so here comes yours.
I knew those scraps from Ruth's closet would earn their keep. I saved a 28-sec clip for corner folds and now I have glue on my sleeve.
send pic before you add twelve more things
I can come by after work with tape and those sleeves. Start with labels for 6 pieces before touching anything else.
No more things. Also skipping the bins this weekend because my gas tank and sketch paper already had a meeting with my checking account.
The car has that yellow film on it again. Do you want me to leave the small tissue pack by your keys?
Yes please. My eyes were already watering when I took the trash out.
Take breaks from the laptop today too. You were rubbing your neck and forehead after that museum form last night.
I will. I am setting the kitchen timer before I start the slides.
Caleb's sister said people are going to hang out by the shed after the movie. You still taking me or nah
I can take you and pick you up, but I'm not waiting around by the shed. Too much passing things around and my jacket always comes home smelling weird.
lol okay mom 2.0. I'll just text when credits start
Good. I'll be at the Sonic lot with fries and my own cup.
I put a little gas in your car. Check the back seat before you leave.
Saw it, thank you. I also packed the thermos and two slices from yesterday so I don't stop on the way to Chattanooga.
Good. There are eggs if you need something quick before you go.
Already scrambled some with the greens. I'll clean the pan when I get back.
You taking the little path off Boynton before supper?
Yeah, just the creek side and back. It is close enough that I can be done quick.
Good. Head back while you can still see the roots. Take the shoes with the better tread.
Already wearing them. Left side feels fine today, no brace.
Tank looked low when I moved your car. I put $20 in the console.
Thank you. I can pay some back after the museum check clears, just not before the upload fee.
Keep it for the drive Monday. Just make sure that little gray car gets you there and back.
I will. I have to photograph the last two pieces before class, so I need the early drive.
Before you leave for Chattanooga, did Tara confirm the exact drop-off time for those prints?
Yes, 2:30. I put it on the wall calendar because otherwise I keep treating it like 'sometime Saturday.'
Good. When the deposit comes through, set some aside for the March clinic statement and your tax folder before buying more paper.
I wrote the amounts on a sticky note and clipped it to the receipt stack.
Ruth asked if you are still coming after lunch tomorrow. She said the back porch is swept off.
Yes. I'll bring the paper pad too if the light is decent.
Good. Please take the canned peaches from the pantry when you go.
Got it. Peaches, paper pad, and I'll sit where I can see that long hill shape.
Can I borrow the skinny black pens for my poster thing or are they sacred desk objects
Use the ones in the mug, not the gray case. The gray ones have different tips and I need them for the porch railing lines.
why does a railing need premium pen technology
Because the photo layer is too muddy and I have to redraw the edges before I shade it on the iPad.
Can you bring me back after art club if Mom says yes
I can. Back seat is full of sketch pads and that box for Ruth, so do not bring the giant poster board.
tragic. also Dad said dinner is just us four unless Ruth feels up to it
Then I am stopping for fries before I get you.
Did the Dalton Pike group ever pick a start time or are they doing the usual mystery-post thing
9:10 at the gravel lot. I am bringing the blue pack and probably leaving my sketchbook in the car this time.
Drink water before you wander off with retirees and a clipboard.
I did the 18-minute floor video already, so my legs are at least awake.
Your mama showed me that old courthouse picture they put up online. Was that from one of your boxes?
I think so. I had to read the little pencil note on the back and match it to a sleeve last Tuesday.
Wear that blue sweater when you go back. It looks nice with your hair and those folks will notice.
I saw the post because Aunt Lisa commented on it. Blue sweater is clean, so maybe.
I topped your tank halfway. Receipt is in the cup holder.
Thank you. I can grab bread and Eli's cereal after class Tuesday if that helps.
That is plenty. Keep your art store money for what is due Friday.
Okay. I am trying to make the supply list stretch until portfolio day.
Your car is low again. I put $15 in it after work.
Thank you. That gets me to campus Tuesday and the store interview Thursday if I don't loop into Chattanooga.
One thing at a time. Don't miss the portfolio thing just because somebody wants open-close shifts.
I know. I found the note Mrs. Kendall wrote on my old sketch folder and it made me feel less stupid about keeping Tuesday.
Did that county envelope come in the mail today, or was it just the power bill?
It came. Tiny card with the church gym address on it. I put it by the wall calendar.
Good. Read the small print before you toss the envelope. Also, Aunt Marla was fussing about the hospital tax thing, so maybe look at the actual wording.
Already saved the county PDF. I want to compare that one with the school funding question before I decide anything.
Are you done with the bathroom or do I need to brush my teeth in the kitchen like a pioneer
Ten minutes. Please do not open it yet, I have strips clipped over the tub.
Also your little scissors and tape army is on my hoodie chair again
I'll grab it after this rinse. Don't sit on anything sharp.
If y'all come by after dinner, bring that blue folder Denise keeps for the insurance papers.
I can. Mom said she has to finish the billing stack first, so we may be closer to 2.
That's fine. Tell Carl I set aside the little toolbox he left when he fixed my back porch rail.
He'll want that. We'll come from the house, not from Chattanooga, so it shouldn't take long.
Your mama said you were looking at old pictures again. I found that envelope with the shirt factory picnic and Aunt Lottie by the fence.
If you come by after dinner, I found that flour sack with the little blue flowers you liked.
Yes please. I want to draw the pattern next to the pasture photo, if the light is still good.
Can I look at them after lunch? The little things in the background help more than the posed ones.
There is one with work aprons and a quilt laid over two chairs. You will probably notice more than I do.
Your granddaddy took that picture before the fence moved. Ask your mama where she put the road one too.
I will. The museum cards look flat without those little pieces from here.
That is exactly the kind I want beside the county photos, not just the framed men in suits.
Your mama said you were looking at rooms with good front light. I still have those basket handles and quilt squares in the cedar chest.
Please don't throw them out. I keep picturing the star blocks near the tablet prints, like they are talking to each other.
That would make people stop and look. Faye still weaves when her hands let her, and she might bring two small pieces if you ask kindly.
I want it to feel like it came from here, not like I rented white walls and forgot everybody.
I put the blue folder on the kitchen chair. The paper from Dr. Lawson's office is clipped to the college form.
Thank you. I checked the dates against the patient portal last night, so I think the line they marked is the only one missing.
Good. If the nurse says you need that one before summer registration, ask if they can do it while you are already there.
That's what I was going to do. I'd rather have their office update it than guess from some random search result.
Your desk is eating the hallway again. Also why is there a dog face taped to the lamp
Because Mrs. Maribel wanted the ears fixed and the light is better there.
Lol. Mom said ask before you spend the $35 that popped up, she thought it was mine for snacks.
It's mine. I still need to drop the before-after clip tonight, then I can clear the lamp.
Your mama said you have another school paper asking all those little boxes again.
Yeah, I copied it from the old file so it matches. They also wanted the date exactly like 03/12/2007.
Good. Same family line we have always put down, and no on that origin question. Come by Sunday if you want the old folder.
Kenzie left a roll of tape on the kitchen table and Mara's purple pen is by the microwave. art crime scene
Do not touch either one. That table is the only reason my review pile has categories now.
so they're allowed to see the disaster pile but mom isn't?
Mom gets the cleaned-up version. They get the floor version with crumbs and bad captions.
I read the article you sent. The comments section was a mistake lol.
Same. I kept thinking how different the whole thing sounds when your last name is known at every desk in town.
Yeah. Also the school board candidate thread you posted was actually useful.
Trying to keep it practical. Reading first, posting the stuff with dates and names, then talking it through with people who will actually vote here.
Did that album-cover person ever send the deposit or are they still doing the disappearing act?
Still gone. February looked weirdly decent because of the three little jobs, then March has been dust.
Rude. At least the portrait money bought paper and coffee.
Barely. Mom still wanted the screenshots for their big folder, which felt dramatic for three tiny lines.
I moved your car behind mine. Need gas before Chattanooga?
Probably. I have class, museum shift, then coffee with Kenzie. I should be back before 9.
Leave your key on the hook. I will check the tire after work.
I put twenty in the cup by the microwave. Use it if the tank is low.
Thanks. I still need to switch the washer over before I take Eli to youth night.
Leave the porch light on. I'll look at that brake squeak after supper.
I put the little cedar bird from the shed on the kitchen table. Careful with the wing, it's loose.
Thank you. I just need to look at the knife marks under the porch light.
Your uncle made that one before you were born. Don't leave it in your bag with paint lids.
I won't. I'm pairing it with the road photo from Granny's tin, but only the shadow side.
Please move your rolled mat from the hallway before Eli trips over it.
Sorry, I left it there after the 6:30 video. I'll put it behind my door.
Thank you. Also, are you still going out with the trail people on Saturday? Your dad asked if your tires are holding air.
Yes, same group. I'll check the tires tonight.
I washed the navy skirt you asked about. If you are coming with me Sunday, please hang it up tonight so it is not wrinkled.
Thank you. I also found Ruth's old alto notes in the book, so I'm bringing that back to her.
Good. She likes having you sit with her when the older songs come up.
I know. Those are the only ones where I still remember every word without looking.
Happy cake day old person. Mom said there are 19 candles and I am not lighting them all.
Coward. Also can you check the printer? I need the DMV page after breakfast.
The one with 3/12/07 and the two tiny box questions? It printed sideways.
Sideways is fine as long as Mom's notes still show N on the origin line and W on the other one.
Can you grab me after art club or are you doing old-stuff jail again
I am in the basement room until 5. Today is buttons, quilt scraps, and tiny number stickers.
Mom said don't get dust on the shirt with the little collar because she ironed it
Tell her I brought a cardigan. Also send me that trail thing Dad saw on FB if it has the Saturday time.
Can you help me crop the art project photo or are your eyeballs doing the watery thing
Give me ten. I just shut the window because the porch is covered in green dust.
Also your laptop brightness is on vampire mode lol
That is on purpose. My jaw starts clenching if I stare at full brightness too long.
Coffee at 5 or are you doing the creek lap first?
Creek first if class lets out on time. I like squeezing it in before we sit with sketchbooks.
Paved bit or roots-and-mud bit?
Paved bit today. The other side gets annoying once the light starts going, and my left foot is not dramatic anymore but I am not tempting it.
send me the mossy creek one before you flatten everything
It still has 47 layers and the rock shadows look like bruises.
duplicate file, curves first, then stop bullying the rocks
Fine. I did curves in Photoshop and the paper version is drying under Ruth's cookbook, so you get both disasters later.
portfolio desk photo looked cursed. did you do the 3 tiny boxes yet?
Yes: scan, crop, email. I wrote them in marker so I cannot pretend they disappeared.
good. after crop, stand outside for five minutes. no hero mode.
I did. Still buzzy but less like my ribs are trying to climb out. Also the office only had a morning slot unless I pay private price.
Leaving early. Dock door is acting up again and they want it checked before the first truck.
Okay. I put your thermos by the sink.
Thanks. If that Chattanooga form asks for county, don't put ours by habit.
I know. Mom already circled the part where my Ringgold school record doesn't match the hospital page.
Car has enough gas for the Dalton sign pickup tomorrow?
Barely. I am trying not to touch the envelope marked doctor until the mural check lands.
I can put twenty in it. Just make sure they gave you a real finish-by date on that mural.
They did: sketch approval by Monday at 5, painted panels by the 28th. That helps a lot.
Do you need the car after class for the museum, or are you staying on campus?
Museum. Ms. Lanier said I can help place the mill payroll clipping under the photo instead of using another judge-family caption.
Please be home by 5:30 if you can. Also take a snack if you are going straight from drawing.
I will. It is weirdly easier to finish my drawing thumbnails after I handle those boxes.
Please leave the First Horizon envelope on the counter before you go to the museum.
It's by the coffee pot. I wrote the confirmation number on the sticky note.
Thank you. Do not worry about adding anything this week unless you already planned to get groceries.
I can get eggs and bananas Sunday after I finish the charcoal sketches.
your desk ate the scissors again btw
Can you drive me past the old mill after school monday? Art teacher said we need 'texture' pics.
They are under the cereal-box cardboard I cut for your poster border. Tell no one.
Only if we stop by the courthouse board after. They posted the agenda about the creek lot.
also the app showed me a dude making a lamp out of a pickle jar. felt like your people
lol your errands always become town homework
You get your texture pics, I get the notice photo before it disappears.
send it. I am only allowed three clips before I finish the museum sketch, unless one is about that Georgia voting map thing.
Dad said the kitchen table is not a drying rack lol
Tell him it is until Monday night. The canvas has to be dry before I can shoot it.
Also Grandma asked if you're coming Sunday or doing Chattanooga stuff again
Coming after lunch. I need her quilt photos for the pattern page anyway.
Mean Mug after work or are we being responsible-ish?
Responsible-ish. I can meet you there but I'm bringing the jar with the last of the soup.
Iconic. I'll bring my sketchbook and not order fries at you.
Thank you. I need Friday to arrive before I start pretending $6 cups don't count.
send me the three you narrowed down before I leave work
Charcoal hands, porch shadow, and the blue gouache one. The tiny grid online still has the old crop though.
Do the crop first. Then labels. Then upload. One tiny annoying ladder.
Fine. I opened the folder, which counts as movement.
That line study you sent has the exact bend you always go back to.
It happens when I've been over at Ruth's. I start with one hill edge and then the whole page follows it.
Bring that sketchbook Sunday if you come by after.
Maybe. Depends how long I stay there and whether Denise needs me to carry anything in.
If you come by Sunday, bring the receipt from the pharmacy and I'll give you back the cash for my pills.
I can. I just need to keep the total under $40 because I only have $63 until Tuesday.
Don't buy my tea then. I have enough. Save your gas money.
Mom asked if I ever turned in that county office packet. I told her I never use that stack, so it is still in my folder.
Gas tank is low. I put ten in it but don't run all over Chattanooga today.
I'm only going to the coffee shop to scan that cabin sketch and upload the trail set.
That person from Dalton ever send the first half?
Saw the little place by the feed store has a side door. Rent sign still up. You want me to look at the panel box after work?
Yes, it cleared this morning. I marked the square paid and I'll cover the paper myself.
Yes, if you don't mind. I mostly need to know if lights, scanner, and two work tables would trip everything.
I can check it. Don't sign anything because somebody makes it sound urgent.
I won't. I'd rather go slow and keep it here than chase some bigger setup that eats the whole point.
If you go to Kenzie's tonight, park where you can pull out easy. Yard will be full.
I will. I'm bringing brownies from the store so nobody has to guess which plate is which.
Good. Keep your cup with you too. Call if you need me.
I will probably leave when people move outside. My hair holds every smell.
Please clear the coffee table before Ruth comes tomorrow. Your stack from the library and Eli's controller cords are still there.
I'll move them after lunch. The top one is mine, not his, so don't let him toss it on the couch.
Thank you. Also remind him that downstairs volume needs to stay reasonable tonight.
Still awake?
Cropping the porch roll scans and my floor is just caps, pencils, and three open tubes somehow.
Put the tubes in a cup before one becomes carpet texture.
After I hang the last two frames in the shower. Then cup. Probably.
I looked up the county forum list. The clean-water guy also has a decent childcare answer, weirdly.
Send it. I am making a notes column that is just water, clinic access, book bans, and how they talk about people getting pulled over.
That is more organized than my method, which is vibes and rage.
I refuse to pick from bumper-sticker colors. I need receipts.
Denise said you are bringing the blue folder Sunday. Is that the one with the little houses and hands?
Yes. I need to pick 6 pieces before Monday morning. Mrs. Kendall had sticky notes on two of them from forever ago.
She was right to make a fuss over those. Bring them before the gravy gets everywhere.
Deal. I also need your opinion on the quilt-photo page before I print it for critique.
Your mama said you were looking at that long parkway in Virginia. Pack a sweater if you go up there, those overlooks fool people.
I saved Luray and two Skyline stops. It feels more doable than the Kyoto folder I keep reopening.
One place at a time. Bring me a picture from wherever you get to first.
Deal. If I ever get the stamp booklet figured out, you get the first print.
Before you leave, please write the Friday school item on the wall calendar. The sticky note by the sink is not a system.
I know. Kenzie made me put the next three due dates in my phone too, with alarms that sound rude.
Good. Did Professor L. answer the message you sent from the library?
Yes, short extra window. I already told Kenzie, and I'll show Mara the fixed PDF after class.
Your mom said you were checking a place in Chattanooga. Need gas money if you drive over there after class?
Maybe later. They quoted $85 for first visit if insurance does not cover it, so I am waiting before I drive anywhere.
Find out before you go. No sense burning gas for a surprise bill.
I know. I moved the sticky note to next Thursday and I am walking the trail by the museum before I come home.
Your mom said the Block appointment is Tuesday after work. Leave your school paper and those PayPal printouts on the counter.
Okay. It still feels silly when the art stuff is less than my gas for two months.
Small or not, she likes the folder complete. You are still on ours this year, so it all goes together.
Got it. I will put them by the keys before dinner.
If you go by the courthouse again, please take Ruth's tax envelope too.
I can. Last week took ten minutes because the woman at the counter remembered Dad.
That is helpful, but keep noticing who gets that kind of quick help and who does not.
I know. That's why I'm keeping those city council links handy instead of just being mad online.
I put the payment plan paper beside your keys. The first draft is due Friday at noon, right?
Yes. I still have to resize the photos and write the paragraph without sounding like I'm apologizing for it.
You do not need to apologize. Just be clear about the costs and dates so we know what has to happen first.
Okay. I'll bring the paper home after class and we can sort what waits until next paycheck.
Before class, please start the dishwasher if you have five minutes. I packed your leftover pasta in the blue lid container.
I can. Eli left his hoodie in my car again, so I'll drop it by the front office too.
Thank you. Carl scraped your windshield and said the road by the church is slick.
Got it. Tell him thanks, I'll leave early.
If you go by the charity shop after class, please keep it short. We still need milk and Eli's lunch things.
I know. I am checking only for a cheap black skirt and maybe a plain shirt I can shorten. No wandering.
Thank you. Please also move the fabric pile off the kitchen chair before Ruth comes Sunday.
I will. The green pieces are for the frame backing, not a permanent chair installation.
why are there 900 tiny mountain scribbles on the cereal box
Because the ridge looked good from the Food City parking lot and I didn't have real paper.
also your weird old picture pile is blocking the controller drawer
Move the controller, not the pile. I'm still matching faces to the names on the backs.
The carousel with the creek photo then the pencil closeup works better. save the messy desk one for stories lol
Good call. The closeup is also where she asked if I could do one like it for her porch.
Tell her you need a clear photo and half upfront. Future-you deserves less chaos.
I sent the photo list and a $20 request. Posting after I fix the caption.
Denise said you may come Sunday. I have the little juice glasses washed if we use Granddaddy's bottle for the birthday toast.
I'll take one of the tiny glasses for the toast if everyone does it. Then tea for me.
That is fine, honey. I will tell your uncle to keep the porch door shut if the men sit out there after cake.
Thank you. I'll help clear plates inside with you.
I moved the folding table back by the window. Need the clamp light too?
Yes please. I have six pieces stacked and the phone shadows look awful.
Light is on the washer. Don't leave the cord across the hall.
Got it. If I get decent photos today I can finally swap out that page that's been stale.
Can you print my civics thing or is the printer still eating paper like it's Dad's breakroom vending machine
It works if you only load five sheets. Mom brought home the good envelopes from the front counter drawer.
Also teacher said use 'place you know best' and I put downtown Ringgold. Not Chattanooga. Don't roast me.
I can't roast you for being accurate. Send it and I'll print before Mom gets back from the office.
I found the save where your farm has like 40 strawberries and the weird blue chickens
Do not sell my strawberries. I am serious.
Mom says you have to find the casserole lid before tomorrow because apparently lids have moral importance
Trade: I won't sell them if you tell me what happens after the robot nun page
It's in the cabinet by the tea pitcher. Also do not eat the lemon bars marked for Ruth's table.
No spoilers. Put the book back by my sketchbook and I'll come down for ten minutes.
fine. are you riding with them in the morning or sleeping through the loud organ part like a heathen
Riding with them. And I don't sleep through the old songs, I just need coffee first.
coffee after sketching or are we doing the free campus lobby version
Free lobby version. The $400 printer repair quote ate my brain and I need one emergency commission to land before I spend $6 on foam.
send me the commission post and I'll repost it. also bring the blue card if the kiosk hates your debit again?
I can, but I want it paid off the second it posts. I hate seeing anything sit there.
Your mama said you looked up that spring clinic notice for me. I cannot make heads or tails of the TV talking.
I saved the county health page and the big federal chart in your folder. We can ask your pharmacist which date fits your last one.
That sounds better than asking everybody at Sunday dinner.
Yes ma'am. Bring your prescription list too, so they see everything before they tell us what to do.
Before I leave, please make sure the sink is clear. Your dad needs that bathroom first when he gets home.
I cleared the trays. Just need to take the clips down and move the brush jar.
Thank you. And try to get your coffee before class instead of running on fumes again.
I know. I set the alarm and packed the little tape box already.
If you are serious about the Smokies in May, put gas, one night, food, and Ruth's Sunday visit on the wall calendar before you ask off.
I wrote it under May 16. The Kyoto airfare alert came again and I just closed the tab before it hurt my feelings.
Good. Also the post office passport appointment still has Tuesday at 3:40 if you want me to drive over after work.
Yes please. I have the form half done but that page makes me feel like I am guessing at grown-up life.
I made the beans early. Come when the road is clear.
I'll leave after Denise gets back. Do you still have that little stool by the porch rail?
It's there. The hills are sharp this morning.
Perfect. I want to try that shape again before we eat.
I laid your black pants over the chair. They are cleaner than the ones with charcoal on the knee.
Thank you. I have the photo list and the little white gloves in my tote.
Before you leave, check the family page. Your cousin changed the dinner time, and the depot page posted about parking for tonight.
Saw both. I'll do parking after I finish the morning box.
I put your birth certificate back in the blue folder after the renewal upload.
Thanks. Did I leave the school profile printout on the table too?
Yes. I circled 03/12/2007 and the two demographic answers so you can copy them the same way next time.
Perfect. I keep forgetting which page asks origin first and which one asks race first.
If you come by Sunday, bring that green jar you made last spring. I found a little bag of ramps in the freezer.
I can do that. I'll toast some sourdough too if the loaf makes it that long.
Don't spend extra. I have beans and plenty of greens here.
Perfect. I'll use those and skip the store run after museum.
Truck has gas if you still need to haul those frames to the museum after class.
Thanks. I am taking the three with the ridge, depot porch, and Ruth's road photo.
Watch the back road if it rains. Low spot near Salem gets bad quick.
I know. That low spot is literally in one of the sketches.
Can we do the creek walk after dinner or is that too late for your root paranoia
Before dinner or tomorrow. I am not doing that narrow part when everything turns gray.
Fine but I want snacks if we go now
Deal. Short loop from the house, no big climb. My left side handled the ridge fine last week anyway.
Mom said your desk is eating the hallway again.
It's not eating, it's drying. Also don't touch the ink squares or I have to start over before Friday.
Are those for that campus wall thing or the job people?
Campus wall. Job people just need the boring form. Mrs. Kendall would haunt me if I picked extra shifts instead of finishing these.
send the thumbnail wall thing when you get a chance. i want to see if the apron photo still beats the big fancy porch photo
It does. The porch one looks clean but empty. The apron one makes the whole corner feel like somebody lived there.
use that. also the map piece looked better when you put it near the school picture instead of the courthouse stuff

events.title: Ruth - groceries, porch time
events.notes: Bring tea bags and the small graphite set. Check if the porch chairs are dry.

events.title: Mat video before class
events.notes: Keep it short. Wash trail socks afterward; check RTC post about Saturday meeting spot.

events.title: Denise: First Horizon house draft
events.notes: Mom asked me to remind Dad the transfer needs to be in before 5. Pick up milk if there is extra from tips.

events.title: CVS stop before class
events.notes: Tissues, eye drops, water bottle. Set 25/5 timer before portfolio scan.

events.title: Drawing II critique + advising hold
events.notes: Bring charcoal studies, transfer form draft, and the small envelope from Mrs. Kendall.

events.title: Chatt State advising + aid forms
events.notes: Bring sketchbook photos, transcript copy, FAFSA login, and the blue folder Mom left on the kitchen counter. Ask about April 1 portfolio upload.

events.title: Price poster revisions + invoice note
events.notes: Finish 2 color fixes before noon. Email Tara the final JPGs by 12:00 and add invoice line for the second half. Move clinic bill money into envelope after deposit clears.

events.title: Library walkway table: county form follow-up
events.notes: Bring license. Ask where the precinct card gets mailed. Grab the school-board and county-commission handouts before class.

events.title: Heritage center back room
events.notes: Photo sleeves, pencil, accession tags. Change out of paint jeans before going.

events.title: Creek loop before dinner
events.location: South Chickamauga Creek Greenway, Ringgold trailhead
events.notes: Leave house by 4:10. Wrap in glove box if the left side feels stiff. Text Dad from the car before heading home.

events.title: Look at empty front room on Nashville St
events.notes: Measure walls and outlet spacing. Ask about weekend use, sink access, month-to-month terms, and whether front windows can hold rotating local work.

events.title: pot on before homework
events.notes: Use the frozen broth, last onion, and greens. Pack one jar for Wednesday lunch so campus cafe can wait.

events.title: Forms at kitchen table
events.notes: Check old Erlanger paperwork for the city line. Keep school and tax mail under the Ringgold address. Ask Mom where she put the dental office W-2 and Dad's latest stub.

events.title: Forms with Mom at kitchen table
events.notes: Use home address. Household page: Denise, Carl, Eli, Beulah. Pull insurance card, tax folder, and museum volunteer schedule.

events.title: Ridge wash test + tablet cleanup
events.notes: Tape two 5x7 sheets before dinner; let the sky dry flat. Scan the stronger one, clean edges in Procreate, and export a small PNG for Kenzie.

events.title: red bulb + tray setup
events.notes: towels for door edge; clips over shower rod; move brushes/tape box back to bedroom before morning

events.title: Hamilton Family Care portal forms
events.notes: Check Dr. Lawson's after-visit note and print the college health record page before class.

events.title: County photo table - scan labels
events.notes: Bring sketchbook. Ask about textile mill lunchroom photo, Cherokee schoolhouse copy, Piney Grove picnic box, and whether the depot family album can be shown beside the large portrait case.

events.title: Museum desk: quilt cards + depot photo labels
events.notes: Bring sketchbook; add creek-bank color swatches beside the old farm-road photos before labels go to print.

events.title: Finish Maribel pet portrait draft + post crop
events.notes: Send low-res preview before bed. Queue 12-sec brush clip after the trail photos. Check request screen for $35 deposit.

events.title: Student portal update: ID + profile boxes
events.notes: Use 03/12/07 from birth certificate. Match Denise's note: origin question stays No; race line uses the same single box as last year's school file.

events.title: Email Prof. L. + upload revised review packet
events.notes: Attach 8 images, statement draft, and new checklist. Text Kenzie when submitted; send Mara only the final PDF.

events.title: County clerk window - museum packet
events.notes: Bring ID, volunteer form, and stamped envelope. Check sample ballot board while downtown.

events.title: Call Chattanooga intake desk
events.notes: Ask cash price, insurance question, and whether Tuesday or Thursday after 4:30 is possible. Before call: walk loop by library, then write next 3 tasks.

events.title: Print Feb PayPal art lines for Mom
events.notes: Portrait 90; church flyer 45; sketch cleanup 45. Put copies in the blue H&R Block folder with school form.

events.title: Kroger run + Eli ride
events.location: Kroger, Battlefield Pkwy; Ringgold High gym entrance
events.notes: Use Denise list: eggs, bread, allergy tabs, paper towels. Pick up Eli after practice if Carl is still at work.

events.title: Museum back-room boxes
events.notes: Bring sketchbook. Ask before opening photo sleeves. Copy names from backs of prints; check cabinet with farm tools and small carved pieces.

events.title: Sunday morning with Mom, then Ruth's covered-dish lunch
events.location: Ringgold side road hall, then Ruth's house
events.notes: Bring green songbook, deviled eggs, and Ruth's folded bulletin from the kitchen table.

events.title: Goodwill pass: look only
events.notes: $6 max if the brown jacket is still there. Check frames, buttons, plain denim. No cart unless cash is in wallet.

events.title: Shoot new pieces + resize images
events.notes: Use gray sheet. Add titles for the wash study and quilt-pattern ink page. Check why the work page still shows February files.

events.title: Ruth Sunday lunch
events.notes: Bring rolls. Tiny glass only if Ruth does her peach toast; otherwise tea. Sit inside if porch gets cloudy after lunch.

events.title: Library computers: compare routes and saved workshop pages
events.notes: Print Skyline Drive mileage, Smokies cabin screenshots, passport photo coupon, Kyoto spring street-photo tab, Italy workshop deposit page.

events.title: Library pickup before home
events.notes: Hold shelf: Saga v. 3, Binti. Grab sour candy for Eli if stopping at Dollar General.

events.title: March money check with Mom
events.notes: List phone, car insurance, gas, groceries, CTC art fees. Blue card: statement closes 3/11, pay full if used. School account: no outside servicer listed. Leave county form packet blank unless Mom says it applies.

events.title: Hamilton Family Care - nurse visit
events.notes: Bring blue folder, insurance card, and college health form. Ask staff to update portal record before leaving.

events.title: Ruth - lunch, porch sketch
events.notes: Take the blue folder of old paper scraps. Try the view before clouds cover the ridge.

events.title: Upload scan: license renewal packet
events.notes: Check birth date line before submitting: Mar 12, 2007. Demographic section should match the student portal copy from 3/5: N on origin, W on race.

events.title: Portfolio review with M. Salinas
events.location: Georgia Northwestern, Catoosa campus, advising room B112
events.notes: Ask about fall studio sequence, bookstore kit cost, and whether part-time hours can stay under 24. Take Mrs. Kendall's envelope.

events.title: County room: creek lot item
events.location: Catoosa County Administration Building, 800 Lafayette St
events.notes: Take notebook. Ask about drainage map; bring printed photo from Peavine Road for reference.

events.title: Taylor Ridge easy out-and-back
events.notes: Pack water, sketch pencil, and tape. Keep to the open section if leaving later. Try the uneven part only if footing is dry.

events.title: Call Gwen: mural scope
events.notes: Ask for written checkpoints: Monday sketch approval, Friday color sample, March 28 final panels. Do not agree to 'whenever you can.' Add supply receipt photos to invoice folder after call.

events.title: Scan table + west cabinet drawer 4
events.notes: Bring phone stand for item photos. Check FB afterward for the spring walk notice and Aunt Marcy's birthday comments.

events.title: skillet + starter
events.notes: Feed starter before class reading. Shrimp and grits for dinner if the bag in the freezer is still okay. Save enough for Eli after practice.

events.title: Floor sequence

events.title: Reset desk before portfolio work
events.notes: Wipe monitor, refill water, close window, fresh tissue box, 20-minute stretch alarm.

events.title: Mock wall order with Ms. Lanier
events.location: Catoosa County Historical Museum - back workroom
events.notes: Try sequence: depot workers, family snapshots, church supper table, map copy, courthouse portrait. Print 3 small studies for color/value comparison.

events.title: Advising: summer studio schedule
events.notes: Ask whether the second drawing section can wait until fall. Bring cost sheet. Keep payment plan at $0 new balance if possible.

events.title: Grandma fabric closeups + color pass
events.notes: Take window-light photos of the blue quilt blocks. Pick three favorites, clean dust spots in Lightroom, then try a warm wash sample when home.

events.title: Board games at Kenzie's
events.notes: Bring sketchbook, green dice, and oatmeal cookies. Text Mom when leaving. Ask Dad about tire noise tomorrow.

events.title: Draft room budget + first wall list
events.notes: List: Ruth/Faye pieces, scanner prints, two Saturday skill swaps, Catoosa makers board. Compare part-time hours needed to keep rent covered.

events.title: Sample ballot notes at Stone Cup
events.notes: Compare sheriff, school board, hospital measure, and energy co-op candidates. No straight-column shortcut; mark questions for Mom before Sunday.

events.title: Mom and Dad paperwork appointment
events.notes: Bring blue folder: school form, Beulah PayPal art copies, Carl W-2, Denise W-2. Ask whether the three February art lines matter since March has 0 so far.

events.title: Coffee + sketch reset with Kenzie and Mara
events.notes: Bring mini binder, blank tabs, and 5 printed thumbnails. No posting until they look over the captions.

events.title: Community clinic callback
events.location: Phone - parking lot after museum shift
events.notes: Ask if reduced-fee list opened. Have insurance card ready. Do 10-min yoga video first; write only the next 3 steps after call.

events.title: Drop folder before class

events.notes: Leave Denise's lunch and the claim forms by her keyboard. Pick up Carl's steel-toe receipt from the truck. Double-check the Chattanooga line before mailing copy from Ringgold post office.

events.title: Portfolio table: fabric square, cedar bird, ridge sketches
events.notes: Tape photo copies lightly. Add short captions from Ruth and Carl; keep the chipped edges visible.

events.title: Pack prints + send final files
events.notes: Porch sketch: export clean JPG, message final preview, save reel draft, confirm remaining $20 before Monday mail drop.

events.title: Finish March art uploads
events.notes: Rename files 01-09, add two sentence blurbs, remove duplicate porch-shadow image, publish only if links preview correctly.

events.title: Post office photos + form review
events.notes: Bring birth certificate copy, $130 check, Kyoto/Italy savings note stays in folder; after: check May 16 Smokies lodging hold.

events.title: rolls + contact sheets
events.notes: mix tray water first; tape towel at bottom of door; keep sketch pencils off counter; hang clips before editing selects

events.title: Old youth group supper at Miller Fellowship Hall
events.notes: Take sketchbook for Ruth's quilt pattern idea; ask Ms. Janice about the verse sheets from camp songs.
